description:
Relive the beautiful nostalgia of the 90s with the evergreen romantic song “Chand Tare Phool” 💖
This 4K restored video song is from the Bollywood film Tum Se Achcha Kaun Hai, featuring the charming performance of Nakul Kapoor that perfectly captures the innocence and romance of that era.

A true classic from the golden days of Hindi cinema, this song continues to touch hearts with its soulful melody and timeless romantic vibes. If you love 90s Bollywood romance, retro love songs, and evergreen Hindi classics, this video is a must-watch 🌙🌸

✨ Watch now in stunning 4K quality and dive into pure nostalgia! 

Song : Chand Tare Phool
Singer : Tauseef Akhtar
Music : Nadeem- Shravan
Lyrics : Sameer
